standard_prerequisites.name: Lemma lemma-check-homomorphism-stalks (canonical tag 007W): a map of sheaves is a homomorphism of algebraic structures iff it is on all stalks
standard_prerequisites.use: Upgrades the set-level adjoint morphism to a morphism of abelian sheaves.

core_obligations: Pi(F) is a sheaf of abelian groups since its sections are products of stalks F_x, each an abelian group, with pointwise operations (Example example-sheaf-product-pointwise-algebraic-structure) (proof lines 1953-1959). Condition (*) of the sheafification construction defines a subgroup: by Lemma lemma-diagram-fibre-product, F^#(U) is the fibre product of a diagram of abelian groups, hence an abelian subgroup of Pi(F)(U); this supplies the counted argument (the author's invitation to find a simpler one is alternative-route rhetoric, not a gap) (proof lines 1960-1974). The map F -> F^# is a morphism of abelian presheaves, and F_x -> F^#_x is an isomorphism of abelian groups by the stalk-sheafification identification (proof lines 1976-1985). Adjointness: transport the set-level sheafification adjointness, and check the resulting map F^# -> G is a morphism of abelian sheaves on stalks, using lemma-check-homomorphism-stalks (proof lines 1987-1991).
proof_roadmap: Give Pi(F) its pointwise abelian sheaf structure and show F^#(U) is a subgroup via the fibre-product description (proof lines 1953-1974).
Record the stalk-level abelian identification F_x \cong F^#_x (proof lines 1976-1985).
Transport the set-level adjointness and verify the abelian property on stalks (proof lines 1987-1991).
